zh.title: 台灣虎航招募30名客艙組員 近三千人報名爭取
zh.summary: 台灣虎航招募30名客艙組員；9月初將開航高雄至小松與石垣島航線。
body: 台灣虎航於2026年8月29日舉行客艙組員招募初試。本次招募預計錄取30名培訓客艙組員，吸引近3000人投遞履歷，經初步書面資料篩選後，約1700人符合資格進入初試，預計於2026年第4季報到。
初試項目包含脫鞋摸高測試與團體面試，著重應試者之語言口條、台風穩定度及臨場反應。通過初試者將於下週進行複試，獲錄取的培訓組員報到後須接受專業地面與空中訓練並通過考核。
此外，因應旅運市場成長，台灣虎航規劃於9月初首航高雄至小松與高雄至石垣島航線，並為2028年起引進第3代機隊積極拓展團隊。公司今年起亦提供員工每年7日福利補休假，並放寬組員配戴眼鏡執勤。

en.title: Taiwan Tigerair Holds Cabin Crew Recruitment Test for 30 Positions
en.summary: Taiwan Tigerair holds recruitment for 30 cabin crew roles while planning September Kaohsiung route expansions.
body: Taiwan Tigerair held preliminary screening tests for cabin crew recruitment on August 29, 2026. The airline received nearly 3,000 applications, with approximately 1,700 candidates passing initial document screening to qualify for the preliminary test. The carrier plans to recruit 30 trainee cabin crew members, who are expected to report for duty in the fourth quarter of 2026.

The carrier is expanding its network to meet growing travel demand, with inaugural flights on the Kaohsiung-Komatsu and Kaohsiung-Ishigaki routes scheduled for early September 2026. The hiring drive also supports capacity expansion for its third-generation fleet, set for delivery starting in 2028. Additionally, Taiwan Tigerair introduced seven days of annual welfare leave this year and now permits cabin crew to wear glasses while on duty.

zh.title: 遭大體型鄰座擠壓5小時 達美航空乘客背痛手術提告
zh.summary: 達美航空乘客稱因鄰座擠壓受困客艙壁，背痛加劇接受手術並提告。
body: 根據 Simple Flying 報導，達美航空（Delta Air Lines）目前面臨一起由搭機旅客發起的法律訴訟案。該起訴訟源於一名乘客在搭乘航班期間所經歷的座位擠壓事件。
根據原告旅客的說法，在一趟長達 5 小時的飛行航程中，由於鄰座為一名體型較大的乘客，導致該名旅客全程被困並緊貼於客艙牆壁旁。
該名旅客表示，這種長時間遭受擠壓的情況導致其背部疼痛嚴重加劇，最終不得不接受昂貴的脊椎手術治療。原告因而針對該次飛行事件向達美航空提出訴訟。

en.title: Passenger Sues Delta Air Lines After 5-Hour Flight Leads to Spinal Surgery
en.summary: Delta Air Lines faces a lawsuit after a passenger claimed seating squeeze led to spinal surgery.
body: Delta Air Lines faces a lawsuit filed by a passenger following a five-hour flight, according to a report by Simple Flying. The legal action alleges that physical conditions during the flight resulted in severe injuries requiring surgery.

The traveler stated that he was trapped against the cabin wall for the entirety of the five-hour flight. He alleged that the physical confinement occurred because he was seated next to a plus-size seatmate.

According to the lawsuit claims, being squeezed against the cabin wall caused worsening back pain during and after the journey. The passenger asserts that the injury ultimately necessitated costly spinal surgery.

zh.title: 英國航空遭乘客提告 掉落瓶子致眼部傷害與腦震盪
zh.summary: 英國航空遭乘客起訴；掉落瓶子致眼部持續傷害；機組急救後引發腦震盪與複視
body: 英國航空（British Airways）目前面臨一起法律訴訟。根據 Simple Flying 報導，一名女性乘客在搭乘航班期間於睡夢中遭掉落的瓶子擊中，並導致眼睛遭受持續性傷害。
事發當時，航班上的機組人員曾進行急救處理，嘗試撫平該名乘客頭部所產生的頭皮裂傷。然而，機組人員所提供的急救措施最終未能撫平相關傷勢。
該起頭皮裂傷隨後導致更嚴重的後續症狀。乘客在事故發生後出現腦震盪，並相繼引發創傷後壓力症候群（PTSD）相關症狀以及複視等長期身體傷害。

en.title: British Airways Sued After Falling Bottle Leaves Passenger With Lasting Eye Damage
en.summary: British Airways faces lawsuit after falling bottle injures passenger; crew first aid followed by concussion and double vision.
body: British Airways is facing a lawsuit after a falling bottle struck a sleeping passenger, causing lasting eye damage. The legal action stems from an in-flight incident where the passenger sustained physical injuries while asleep on board.

According to details reported by Simple Flying, cabin crew members provided initial first aid to treat a scalp laceration. However, the first aid measures failed to soothe the injury sustained by the passenger.

The scalp laceration ultimately resulted in severe secondary medical conditions. The passenger subsequently experienced a concussion, post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) symptoms, and double vision following the event.

zh.title: 美軍於德州邊境發射雷射 擊落三架販毒集團無人機
zh.summary: 美軍南方邊境聯合任務部隊於德州擊落三架無人機；運用高能雷射系統反制威脅
body: 美國美軍「南方邊境聯合任務部隊」（Joint Task Force–Southern Border, JTF-SB）於2026年8月28日證實，任務部隊人員在2026年8月25日與26日的深夜時段，於德克薩斯州南部的里奧格蘭德山谷（Rio Grande Valley）動用陸軍「多用途高能雷射」（AMP-HEL）系統，成功攔截並擊落三架無人航空系統（UAS）。這項行動標誌著美軍定向能量武器在面對遭判定為具敵意無人機時的實戰運用。

美軍官方指出，相關無人機因直接支援對美軍地面人員及美國海關暨邊境保護局（CBP）執法人員構成實體威脅的活動，因而被歸類為敵意目標。南方邊境聯合任務部隊指揮官柯蒂斯·泰勒少將（Maj. Gen. Curtis Taylor）表示，犯罪集團與販毒網絡正日益增加無人航空系統的使用，藉此協助非法人口走私，並針對執法人員與美軍哨所進行偵察監控。美軍目前未公開擊落行動的精確地理座標，亦未說明無人機遭摧毀時是位於美國還是墨西哥領空。
此次行動中所使用的 AMP-HEL 系統是由 AeroVironment 開發的機動式反無人機防禦裝備，該公司於2025年向美國陸軍交付首批兩架原型樣機。該系統透過發射高濃縮雷射能量使小型無人機癱瘓或摧毀，旨在提供一種無需消耗傳統導彈或彈藥的高效益反無人機防禦手段。美軍北方司令部表示，本次邊境行動已與區域合作夥伴進行協調，但基於作戰安全考量，拒絕提供進一步細節。

這次雷射反制行動隨後遵循了先前建立的安全規範。在2026年2月，美軍雷射反無人機系統曾在德州漢考克堡（Fort Hancock）附近誤擊一架 CBP 無人機，並引發美國聯邦航空管理局（FAA）劃設臨時飛行限制。此外，埃爾帕索（El Paso）附近的反無人機行動亦曾導致埃爾帕索國際機場（ELP）周邊空域短暫關閉。美國聯邦航空管理局與五角大廈隨後制定了全新作業程序，允許軍方防空雷射在商業民航流量附近運作而無需關閉機場，評估確認在遵守相應安全措施下不會對客機構成不當風險。

en.title: US military high-energy laser shoots down three drones along Texas border
en.summary: Joint Task Force–Southern Border used a high-energy laser to destroy three drones along the Texas border.
body: Personnel assigned to the Joint Task Force–Southern Border (JTF-SB) engaged and destroyed three unmanned aircraft systems (UAS) using an Army Multipurpose High Energy Laser (AMP-HEL) during the late-night hours of August 25 and August 26, 2026. The engagements took place in the Rio Grande Valley in southern Texas near the United States–Mexico border. Military officials stated that the directed-energy weapon was deployed after determining that the aircraft posed a direct physical threat to US military personnel and US Customs and Border Protection (CBP) agents operating in the sector.

According to military statements, the drones were identified as hostile because they were directly supporting criminal activities that compromised the safety of law enforcement and defense personnel. Joint Task Force–Southern Border Commander Maj. Gen. Curtis Taylor highlighted that cartel networks are increasingly employing unmanned aircraft systems to facilitate human-smuggling operations and conduct aerial surveillance on border personnel. Defense authorities declined to disclose the exact coordinates of the engagements or specify whether the targeted drones were located above US or Mexican territory when destroyed.

The AMP-HEL system involved in the engagement is a mobile laser counter-drone platform developed to disable or destroy small unmanned aircraft using concentrated light energy. Manufacturer AeroVironment delivered the first two AMP-HEL prototypes to the US Army in 2025 to establish a cost-effective counter-UAS capability without expending conventional missiles or munition stockpiles. US Northern Command confirmed that border engagements were coordinated with regional enforcement partners, though additional operational specifics remain restricted to protect ongoing security tactics.

The recent operational use of counter-drone laser technology follows earlier safety adjustments along the southern border. In February 2026, a military laser counter-drone system mistakenly downed a CBP drone near Fort Hancock, Texas, which prompted initial flight restrictions by the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA). A separate operation near El Paso also temporarily affected airspace surrounding El Paso International Airport (ELP). Consequently, the FAA and the Pentagon established specialized procedures allowing military lasers to operate near civil air traffic safely without necessitating commercial airport closures.
